string-array.item: Which single number reaches police, fire and ambulance anywhere in India?|112|1098|139|0|112 is the all-in-one emergency number. It works from any phone, even without balance.
Which number is the Women Helpline?|1930|181|139|1|181 is the Women Helpline in most states. 1091 reaches the women police helpline.

Where do you report online harassment, blackmail or cyber fraud?|Helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in|Only at the phone company|It cannot be reported|0|Call 1930 or file a complaint on cybercrime.gov.in. Keep screenshots as evidence.

A police station says the incident happened outside its area. What can you ask for?|Nothing, you must travel there|A Zero FIR|A written apology|1|Any police station must register a Zero FIR and transfer it to the right station.

Can the police arrest a woman after sunset and before sunrise?|Yes, at any time|Never, under any circumstances|Only in exceptional cases, by a woman officer with a magistrate\'s written permission|2|The law protects women from night arrests except in exceptional cases with a magistrate\'s prior written permission.

Before you get into a cab you booked, what should you check?|That the number plate and driver match the app|That the car is clean|That the driver is in a hurry|0|Always match the plate and the driver with the booking. Cab mode in this app can share the plate with your contacts.

Your cab takes a route you do not recognise. What is the best first step?|Stay quiet and wait|Share your live location, call someone and ask to stop at a busy place|Switch off your phone|1|Let someone know where you are, say it aloud on a call, and use SOS if you feel threatened.

At a workplace with 10 or more employees, who must hear a sexual harassment complaint?|The Internal Committee|Only the police|The security guard|0|The POSH Act requires every such workplace to have an Internal Committee.

How long do you have to file a workplace sexual harassment complaint under the POSH Act?|24 hours|One week|Three months from the incident|2|The complaint should be made within three months, and the committee can extend this by another three.

Someone keeps following you or messaging you after you clearly said no. Is that a crime?|No, it is only bad manners|Yes, stalking is a crime, online too|Only if they touch you|1|Stalking, in person or online, is a criminal offence. Save the messages and report it.

Does the domestic violence law cover only physical violence?|Yes, only physical violence|No, also verbal, emotional, sexual and economic abuse|It covers only married women|1|The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act covers all these forms of abuse, and women in live-in relationships too.

Who is entitled to free legal aid in India?|Every woman, whatever her income|Only women below the poverty line|Nobody, lawyers always charge|0|Every woman can get free legal aid through the Legal Services Authority in her district.

Can the media or anyone else publish the name of a survivor of sexual assault?|Yes, if the news is true|Only on social media|No, revealing her identity is an offence|2|Disclosing the identity of a survivor of sexual assault is a punishable offence.

You are walking alone at night and feel that someone is following you. What do you do?|Go straight home by the quietest lane|Move towards a lit, busy place and call someone|Stop and confront them alone|1|Head for people and light, stay on a call, and do not lead the person to your home.

You left your drink unattended at a party. What is the safe choice?|Finish it quickly|Ask a stranger to taste it|Leave it and get a fresh one|2|An unattended drink can be tampered with. Always get a new one.

What is the fake call tool in this app for?|To give you a believable reason to leave an uncomfortable situation|To prank your friends|To call the police|0|A fake incoming call lets you step away without a confrontation.

What happens when you enter your duress PIN in this app?|The app is deleted|The app looks normal but silently sends an SOS|Nothing happens|1|The duress PIN is for when someone forces you to unlock. It opens the app normally and alerts your contacts in secret.

When a woman reports a sexual offence, who should record her statement?|Any officer on duty|A woman police officer|A neighbour|1|The law requires her statement to be recorded by a woman police officer.

You are meeting someone from the internet for the first time. What is the safest plan?|Meet in a public place, tell a friend and arrange your own travel|Meet at their home|Let them pick you up from your home|0|A public place, a friend who knows your plan and your own way home keep you in control. Meeting mode can set a timer for you.

A caller says they are from your bank and asks for the OTP you just received. What do you do?|Share it, they are from the bank|Share only half of it|Never share it and end the call|2|No bank ever asks for an OTP. Sharing it lets someone take money or control of your account.
Which number is the helpline for a child in distress?|1098|181|112 only|0|1098 is Childline, a free 24-hour helpline for children.

Is giving or taking dowry legal if both families agree?|Yes, if both agree|No, both giving and taking dowry are offences|Only giving is an offence|1|The Dowry Prohibition Act makes giving, taking and demanding dowry punishable.

You set a check-in timer in this app and do not tap “I\'m safe” in time. What happens?|Nothing, the timer just ends|The app starts an SOS and alerts your contacts|Your phone restarts|1|A missed check-in starts an SOS, so someone knows even if you cannot reach your phone.
Which number do you call for help while travelling on a train?|139|1930|1098|0|139 is the Rail Madad helpline for safety and other help on Indian Railways.
